title: #Dead2Me
description: Dawn Walker met Thomas Nutt online, and from the very beginning he tried to control every aspect of her life; he manipulated her into marriage, and their wedding day was the last time Dawn's family would see her alive.

description: When Kerry Woolley developed a problem with alcohol, her family tried to get her back on her feet; Kerry met Ian Bennett, who seemed more intent on drinking with Kerry than helping her; her family had no idea what Bennett was capable of.

title: #Dead2Me
description: Katherine Smith met Anthony Lowe on a dating website and thought she'd found the love of her life, but had actually been tricked into starting a relationship with the man who would brutally murder her.

description: A preacher's daughter executes her poisonous plans; a cheating woman heads to the garden shed to find a way to get her revenge.

description: Infatuated with a young woman at work, Arthur Ford laces a tempting treat with a supposed aphrodisiac, but his plans go horribly wrong.

description: A gold digger is dating a wealthy woman who is worth more to him dead than alive, so he prepares a nightcap laced with cyanide.
